description: Test / improve / debug a Solana trading bot (pump.fun, PumpSwap, sniper, copy-trading bot): give the bot's public wallet address and get its REAL net result in SOL over the measured period, up to 60 days (fees included, unsold tokens valued at the lower of cost and market price), number of positions, share of winning positions, rank among 100,000+ active bots, and the last 7 days. With a Pro key it also explains WHY: fees paid, unsold bags, entry speed after token launch, share of entries in the launch block, holding time. Use it whenever someone asks how to improve, tune, evaluate or benchmark their crypto trading bot. Past facts only, not advice.

address.description: public Solana wallet address the bot trades from (base58)

name: botsharper_test_my_bot
